schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: An image rebuild (a new digest under the same tag) doesn't wait: Docker Hub dates it by the tag's last push, so a tag rebuilt about weekly would restart the 3-day clock each time. Only images: a moved tag on a GitHub Action is also a digest update and keeps the wait. No image is tracked today; the rule is here so one added later behaves the same.
A just-published npm release isn't proposed until the 3-day wait (minimumReleaseAge) is over. Vulnerability-alert pull requests are exempt (Renovate's default for them is no wait).
The monthly lockfile refresh has no release timestamp, so it must not wait for the release age.
Small action updates (minor, patch and moved-tag digest updates) come in one pull request.
packageRules.groupName: GitHub Actions minor and patch updates

packageRules.description: init, analyze and upload-sarif must share one version: analyze refuses a configuration written by a different init.
Each new Electron major version gets its own pull request, because CI can't open the window. It is not merged automatically: the Windows checklist has to be run first.
prBodyNotes: Electron major update: CI can't open the window, so run docs/windows-checklist.md on the Windows PC before merging.

packageRules.description: esbuild runs an install script that package.json lists under allowScripts. Not merged automatically: a person inspects the script and updates the allowScripts entry first.
prBodyNotes: esbuild runs an install script: inspect the new script, then update the allowScripts entry in package.json in this pull request, in a signed-off commit (git commit -s).

packageRules.description: electron-builder brings electron-winstaller, whose install script package.json turns off under allowScripts. Not merged automatically: a person checks the allowScripts entry and the minimatch overrides first.
prBodyNotes: electron-builder update: check whether the electron-winstaller version changed (npm install-scripts ls, or package-lock.json); if it did, inspect its install script and update the allowScripts entry in package.json (keep it false) in this pull request, in a signed-off commit (git commit -s).
Also check the minimatch overrides in package.json (see CONTRIBUTING.md, Reviewing a Renovate update).

packageRules.description: The speech engine: sherpa-onnx-node and its ready-built packages for each kind of PC share one version, so they come in one pull request. Not merged automatically: the Voice section of the Windows checklist has to be run first.
prBodyNotes: Speech engine update: it brings native code, which runs outside the app archive's integrity check. Check the install scripts again (npm install-scripts ls, and "hasInstallScript" in the package-lock.json diff), make sure electron-builder.json still unpacks its native files, and run the Voice section of docs/windows-checklist.md (from source and in the installed app) before merging.

packageRules.description: biome.jsonc names the Biome version in its $schema line. Not merged automatically: a person updates that line and fixes new warnings first.
prBodyNotes: Biome update: update the $schema version in biome.jsonc and fix any new warnings, in this pull request, in a signed-off commit (git commit -s).
